title: Suriyassa upamā
text: 2. Suriyassa bhikkhave udayato etam pubbaṅgamam etam pubbanimittaṃ yadidam aruṇuggam || evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno sattannam bojjhaṅgānam uppādāya etam pubbaṅgamam etam pubbanimittaṃ yad idaṃ yonisomanasikāro || || Yonisomanasikārasampannessetam bhikkhave bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ satta bojjhaṅge bhāvessati satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkarissati || || 3. Kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu yoniso manasikārasampanno satta bojjhaṅge bhāveti sattabojjhaṅge bahulīkaroti || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgam bhāveti || pe-la || upekhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāveti vivekavirāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || || Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu yonisomanasikārasampanno satta bojjhaṅge bhāveti sattabojjhaṅge bahulīkarotī ti || ||
